domain_restrictions: n is not zero (so that (n-1)/n is defined), intended as positive integer
F_n is defined at x for such n and x
H_n is defined for such n
semantic_sketch_json.normalized_claim: For all positive integers n and all real numbers x with (n minus 1) divided by n less than or equal to x and x less than 1, the value of F_n at x equals H_n minus 1.

variables.name: n
variables.role: index parameter for functions/values F_n and H_n; denominator in (n-1)/n

witness_dependencies: none (no existential witnesses are introduced); the conclusion depends only on the given n and x satisfying the premise
